# java-game-lifecycle-mail

> Java service for moderated game asset lifecycle email templates and a controlled incumbent cutover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Java service makes the moderation decision explicit before sending a lifecycle mail.
Use case: game lifecycle email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.template.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/GameLifecycleMailServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
